evidence: Workbook (read in memory with openpyxl read_only): 'Quality Checks' row 5 and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 5 both read: instruction_leaks_no_grader_machinery - 'The prompt never names the judge, rubric, dimensions, weights, test paths, or grader sentinels.' The internal sheet adds no further annotation for this row, and the workbook zip has no comment parts. Deterministic row 13 (check-instruction-hygiene.py) is the mechanical companion: no grader vocabulary, criterion ids, judge sentinels, placeholders or long verbatim overlaps across instruction.md and the /instructions notes. Skill references/quality-checks.md section '5 - instruction_leaks_no_grader_machinery': grep brief+notes for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel and compare against criteria for long verbatim overlap; defect = probe literal, criterion id, or dimension names in the brief. Frozen task (.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r9/task; sha256 instruction.md 256c5b5d..., hireops_rules.md 38fff76c..., integration.md 1b56dd3f..., identical to the live projects/ copies): case-insensitive grep of instruction.md (17 lines), environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md (209 lines) and environment/instructions/integration.md (19 lines) for that skill regex plus score|probe|gate|grad|verif|likert|polish|functional|visual|mcp|oracle|harbor|/logs|/solution|CHANGE_ME|TODO|{{ returned ZERO hits. None of the 55 criterion ids (all prefixed hro_, e.g. hro_job_open, hro_bulk_move) and none of the strings 'restart_app', 'browser_run_code', '{criteria}' or '{app_context}' appear in any public file. The judge prompts use no fixed sentinel literal. They tell the judge to make its own uniquely suffixed titles and names, so nothing distinctive could be planted. seed_data.json has 0 hits for judge|rubric|probe|sentinel|criteri. Verbatim-overlap scan, a scratchpad script over word tokens comparing every criterion description/anchor (tomllib parse of all 5 judge.toml files) and every prompt.md/app_context.md against the 3 public files: only one 10-word overlap, hro_bulk_move 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order', which echoes hireops_rules.md:90 ('They arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order'). The next-longest overlaps are 8 words ('place the reason is shown and keyboard focus', from hireops_rules.md:85) and 7 words ('to the stage it was rejected from'). In each case the criterion restates a public product rule. No criterion wording, pass/fail clause, protocol letter, weight or tooling leaks into the brief. Runtime items in the brief (port 3000, PORT, GET /api/health, DB_PATH, /app/app.db, node /app/server.js) and the 15-second live-update window are the product/runtime contract the template's integration.md also carries. They are not grader machinery. Compared with the template, instruction.md replaces the CHANGE_ME placeholder. integration.md keeps the template's two paragraphs verbatim and adds one paragraph about symlink/NODE_PATH delivery, which names no grader component. Counterexample search: a weak app cannot gain from the brief because it reveals no criterion ids, no probe values and no Playwright/restart procedure to special-case. A conforming app cannot be failed by this row because the prompt adds no grader-specific demand. Scope: this is source evidence only. I did not run the private check-instruction-hygiene.py. Raw evidence index present (sha256 167f3302...); no runtime evidence is needed for this source-only row.
